rows.name: North Camano Substation
rows.quote:
To increase reliability on Camano Island, the PUD recently rebuilt the 
North Camano Substation,
 replacing 1960s equipment with modern, efficient, and environmentally responsible equipment.

rows.name: Crosswind Substation
rows.quote:
To increase reliability and support a future battery energy storage system, the PUD has constructed a new 
Crosswind Substation
 on its North County Campus in Smokey Point. Estimated completion is 2026.

rows.name: Lake Goodwin Substation
rows.quote:
To better serve growing power demands in north Snohomish County, the PUD is upgrading its 
Lake Goodwin Substation 
and its 
Stimson Crossing Switching Station 
(estimated completion 2027).

rows.name: Stimson Crossing Switching Station
rows.quote:
To better serve growing power demands in north Snohomish County, the PUD is upgrading its 
Lake Goodwin Substation 
and its 
Stimson Crossing Switching Station 
(estimated completion 2027).

rows.name: Getchell Switching Station
rows.quote:
The PUD is constructing a 
new transmission line
 and switching station in Marysville to meet the needs of a growing north county and provide additional system capacity. The 
Getchell Switching Station
 (completion in 2028) will be located in east Marysville near Highway 9.

rows.name: Clearview Substation
rows.quote:
To better serve the eastern portion of its service area, the PUD upgraded its 
Clearview Substation
 (completed 2024) and will be upgrading the 
Thrashers Corner Substation 
(estimated completion 2027).

rows.name: Thrashers Corner Substation
rows.quote:
To better serve the eastern portion of its service area, the PUD upgraded its 
Clearview Substation
 (completed 2024) and will be upgrading the 
Thrashers Corner Substation 
(estimated completion 2027).

rows.name: Brier Substation
rows.quote:
To better serve the southern portion of its service area, the PUD plans to upgrade its 
Brier Substation 
(estimated completion 2026), and 
Picnic Point Substation
 (estimated completion 2027).

rows.name: Picnic Point Substation
rows.quote:
To better serve the southern portion of its service area, the PUD plans to upgrade its 
Brier Substation 
(estimated completion 2026), and 
Picnic Point Substation
 (estimated completion 2027).

rows.name: Stanwood-to-Camano 115-kV line
rows.quote:
To provide redundant power to Camano Island, the PUD built a new 
Stanwood-to-Camano 115-kV line
 (completed 2023). The rebuild of the existing 115-kV line to Camano Island is estimated to be complete in 2026.

rows.name: Stimson-to-Stanwood 115-kV line
rows.quote:
To better serve the growing power demands in the northern portion of its service area, the PUD is rebuilding its 
Stimson-to-Stanwood 115-kV line
 (estimated completion 2026) and designing and building a new 
Stimson-to-Sills Corner 115-kV line
 (estimated completion 2027).

rows.name: Stimson-to-Sills Corner 115-kV line
rows.quote:
To better serve the growing power demands in the northern portion of its service area, the PUD is rebuilding its 
Stimson-to-Stanwood 115-kV line
 (estimated completion 2026) and designing and building a new 
Stimson-to-Sills Corner 115-kV line
 (estimated completion 2027).

rows.name: Jennings Park Substation
rows.quote:
The PUD recently completed a portion of the new 
115-kV line
 to feed the new Jennings Park Substation in 
Marysville.
 In addition, the PUD will re-conductor about 0.75 miles of 115-kV line near the Jennings Park Substation in 2026.

rows.name: Sky Valley Substation
rows.quote:
The PUD is working on easements and finalizing the design for the 
second phase of the 115-kV line
 to the 
Sky Valley Substation
 (estimated completion 2026).

rows.name: Crosswind Transmission Line
rows.quote:
The PUD is planning to build a 
double-circuit 115-kV line
 to the new Crosswind Substation in 
Arlington
. The 
Crosswind Transmission Line
 project is to support a new battery energy storage system project (estimated completion 2027).

rows.name: 115-kV line connecting its Perrinville and Maplewood substations
rows.quote:
To improve reliability, the PUD will rebuild the 
115-kV line
 connecting its Perrinville and Maplewood substations (estimated completion 2026).

rows.name: new 115-kV line to the new Getchell substation
rows.quote:
To support load growth and improve reliability in 
Everett, Marysville and north Snohomish County,
 the PUD is in the planning stages of building a 
new 115-kV line
 to the new Getchell substation (estimated completion 2027) and a

rows.name: new 115-kV line from the Everett to Delta substations
rows.quote:
to the new Getchell substation (estimated completion 2027) and a 
new 115-kV line
 from the 
Everett to Delta
 substations. (estimated completion 2027).

rows.name: Hat Island submarine cable
rows.quote:
To maintain reliable service to Hat Island, the PUD is planning to replace the 
Hat Island submarine cable 
(estimated completion 2027).
